name: @prosper/client
description: Standalone client portal entrypoint. In Phase 0 the routes live inside /frontend (route group '(client)') and run on the single Next.js dev server. This package exists so the monorepo structure matches the PRD; promote to a fully separate Next.js app in a later phase when productive deploy requires its own domain.

scripts.dev: echo "[client] Phase 0: routes served by /frontend Next.js on port 3000 → http://localhost:3000/client"
